snippet.title: Counter Ducks - Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Public Playtest Sign-ups Are Now Open! 🦆 We're getting ready to launch the first public playtest of Counter Ducks, and you can sign up starting today! 

To celebrate, here's a quick look at the chaotic action waiting for you. Whether you choose to fight as a duck or a hunter, expect plenty of explosions, teamwork, and hilarious moments.

Which side would you choose first: Ducks or Hunters?
